item.title: RC and Electronic Toys: Battery, Radio and Charging Compliance
item.description: A battery turns a simple toy into a product with freight, radio and charger obligations. How to choose the battery, what EN 62115, FCC, PSE and KC actually test, and why button cells need a tool-locked compartment.
